candidates.text: ALSO PURSUANT TO RULE 42, I REMIND ALL IN THE CHAMBER THAT NO DEMONSTRATION OF APPROVAL OR DISAPPROVAL FROM MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE PERMITTED.
WE'RE NOW ON TO THE FIRST ORDER OF BUSINESS, WHICH IS THE APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES FROM THE MEETING OF OCTOBER 21ST, 2026.
THE AYES HAVE IT AND THE MINUTES OF THE OCTOBER 21ST MEETING ARE APPROVED.
TO SUSPEND THE RULES AND PASSED DOCKET 2030, WHICH IS AUTHORIZING THE CITY TO ACCEPT AND EXPEND THE $187,000 GRANT FROM MASS SPORTS EAST BOSTON FOUNDATION FUND.
THANK YOU, MR. CLERK DUNCAN 2030 HAS PASSED.
AND ONE OF HER UM, YOU KNOW, BIG MESSAGES IS ACTIVATING AND SUPPORTING ALL PEOPLE IN VHA TO GET OUT AND VOTE.
I'M LOOKING FORWARD TO VOTING YES IN.

BUT IN THIS IN THE CITY BYLAWS IT DOES GIVE THE OPPORTUNITY FOR THE CITY COUNCIL TO HAVE UM AND TO UNDERSTAND AND HEAR FROM THE MEMBERS WHETHER OR NOT WE WANT TO HAVE THOSE FORMAL HEARINGS AND ON I GUESS IS ANOTHER QUEST
COUNCILOR DURKAN, THE CHAIR OF THE COMMITTEE ON PLANNING DEVELOPMENT AND TRANSPORTATION SIX SUSPENSION OF THE RULES AND PASSAGE OF 2031.
THE PUBLIC AND PANELISTS SPOKE TO THE UNACCEPTABLE RISE AND DEATHS AT THE SUFFOLK COUNTY HOUSE OF CORRECTIONS WHERE MORE THAN 20 INDIVIDUALS HAVE DIED IN THE LAST FIVE YEARS.
CRIME, THEIR FAMILIES TO EXERCISE OUR AUTHORITY WITH URGENT EXAMINATION AND.
THROUGHOUT HIS CAREER HE HAS DEDICATED HIMSELF TO PUBLIC SERVICE WORKING IN CORRECTIONS ,YOUTH SERVICES, MENTAL HEALTH COUNSELING AND CRISIS INTERVENTION.
I'M ALSO CONCERNED THAT THIS WOULD AFFECT, UH, PUBLIC TRUST IF FAMILIES BELIEVE PARTICIPATING.
